turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Why did my son find out about a zero on his phone?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
"If." Did you call me before you entered that zero, or didn't you?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
You want me to do your job for you? Your own procedure says you call the parent before any mark goes in, so start by explaining why you didn't.
